claim: A wire-transfer instruction in the DOJ's Epstein financial production directs the payment of "TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($20,000)" from a Jeffrey Epstein account to the "World Transhumanist Association Inc.," dated September 14, 2010, with a corresponding entry appearing on the account statement. The World Transhumanist Association — now operating as Humanity Plus — is the movement's flagship organization. The New York Times, reporting separately in 2019, documented Epstein's longstanding interest in transhumanism and eugenics, including that he told scientists of an ambition to "seed the human race with his DNA by impregnating women at his vast New Mexico ranch," an interest in cryonics, and that a charity he established gave $20,000 to the same association. The transfer record is a primary financial document from the federal release.
